type.ruling: Modern theme drops Rye from the HUD. Oswald (600, uppercase, +2-4 tracking) for titles, buttons, labels and every number; Old Standard TT stays for prose. Rye is kept only for the logo and big screen titles if you want a western accent.

motion.hover: 120 ms ease-out: swap to *_hover; optional scale 1.02
motion.glow_pulse: primary button glow alpha 0.6 <-> 1.0 over 1.6 s when it is the suggested action

pairs_with: kaleido_suits / suits_parallax_* / <suit>_bg shaders. Panels are ~88% opaque so the background moves faintly behind them; raise alpha if the board needs more calm.
